items.name: Performance Collection
items.description: Collects performance data and sends it to Amazon.

items.name: Performance Counters
items.description: Background performance logging on Fire OS 8 devices.

items.name: Telemetry Emitter
items.description: Sends device telemetry to Amazon (Fire OS 8).

items.name: Content Recognition (ACR)
items.description: Automatic content recognition: identifies what's playing on screen for Amazon's ad and recommendation data.

items.name: Hybrid Advertising ID
items.description: Advertising ID service used for targeted ads.

items.name: Special Offers Background Service
items.description: Background ad service behind Special Offers on Fire OS 8. Saves memory and CPU when off.

items.name: Sneak Peek Previews
items.description: Auto-playing promotional previews on the Home screen.

items.name: Release Notes
items.description: Shows "what's new" pop-ups after Fire OS updates.

items.name: Notification Center
items.description: Amazon's notification panel and promotional notifications. You won't see system notifications while it's off.

items.name: Matter Smart Home
items.description: Matter smart home support. Switch off only if you don't control smart home devices from the TV.

items.name: Matter Co-host
items.description: Lets the Fire TV act as a Matter hub for other devices.

overrides.description: Voice settings menu and input manager. On Fire OS 8 (e.g. Fire TV Stick 4K Max 2nd Gen) some users report a stuck boot logo after disabling it together with other core services - take a snapshot first.
Persistent link to Amazon's servers (sign-in, sync). On Fire OS 8 some users report a stuck boot logo after disabling it - not recommended.
